Nature of business: manufacture and sale of home, office and institutional furniture (solid wood, engineered wood and upholstered products) from the factory at Bhiwandi, Thane, sold through company-owned showrooms, dealers, e-commerce marketplaces and contract supplies.
Basis of preparation: Indian GAAP (Accounting Standards notified under the Companies (Accounting Standards) Rules, 2021), Schedule III Division I format, historical cost convention, accrual basis.
